title: Foldable Flight: The Best Paper Airplanes
why_read: Fun and nostalgic but has essentially zero technical substance for a software engineering audience.
analysis: This is a hobbyist/craft article about folding paper airplanes. It has no connection to software engineering, algorithms, or any technical discipline relevant to this digest. The high engagement on Hacker News likely reflects the community's fondness for playful off-topic content. There is nothing here a software engineer would apply to their work.
